limitations: Creator admission remains closed; this is a temporary infrastructure probe, not product admission or gateway readiness.

DNS-resolved public-management denial and public-to-private redirect were exercised; controlled DNS rebinding was not.
Public HTTPS responses and redirect headers were observed from third-party test services; independent public endpoint access-log correlation was not available.

Fork, memory and temporary-file pressure killed only the candidate through its memory limit. The 1 GiB tmpfs size was observed but ENOSPC was not reached because the 512 MiB memory limit applies first.
Guest thread creation reached 126 additional threads then failed with RLIMIT_NPROC 128; fork-specific pressure reached OOM before producing its final task count.
No host reboot or certificate-renewal cycle was performed in this runtime acceptance subtask.
Candidate failure preserved all five existing tools and their database operations; automatic gateway switching/rollback is not implemented by this operator harness.
